answer: Each name is charged $22 per docket, and 160 dockets before the first reward is released, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. No Pressbound vatman leaf charter, no seat: the rule is plain, and a charter vatmen file after vat room checks is why it holds. gale stays on the record. prism is written on the receipt. The clerk notes whisper.
